check.reason: The target is the system: pharma, investor hype and surrogate-endpoint culture. Patients are not mocked, and 'patients' hearts' is framed sympathetically. No reporters or private individuals are targeted, and there are no invented numbers or quotes. The headline is hyperbolic but consistent with the real story's 'disconnect with outcomes.' It is dry, deadpan and clearly satirical. It does not dwell on death, children or violence.

pick.title: Lp(a)-Lowering Pelacarsen Shows Huge Disconnect With Cardiovascular Outcomes
pick.headline: Drug Flawlessly Improves Lab Value, Declines to Improve Anything Else
pick.take: Lowering the biomarker was the investment thesis, the conference slide, and a healthy share of the stock price. Only the outcomes trial thought to ask whether patients' hearts agreed. The surrogate endpoint remains the one part of the pipeline that reliably delivers on schedule.
